$comment: Inputs for pipeline:basin in reference mode (R3.1). The region is a set of roots, one per APRHI basin (owner, 2026-10-12: precedence APRHI > IGN > HydroRIVERS; scope in DECISSIONS.md 'Córdoba R2'). 'whole' roots take the unclipped polygon from wholeLayer; 'clipped' roots take the Córdoba-clipped polygon from clippedLayer, whose union is also the province edge (APRHI's clip, not IGN's polygon). expectedExitReach is the HydroRIVERS reach where the root ends, read from data/work/cba/basin-gate/report.json (2026-10-12); it must be one of the root's exit candidates, and the report also shows the largest-upland candidate. For 04 they differ on purpose: its largest sink (61509423, 12,495 km²) collects the southern arroyos (Santa Catalina, del Gato, Chucul) that APRHI assigns to 03, reconnected in R3.2, so 04 ends at the Río Quinto sink 61512430 (9,149 km²; HydroRIVERS path from Villa Mercedes checked 2026-10-12). headwaters (root 04): the Río Quinto rises in San Luis, outside the clipped polygon; the step walks its main stem upstream from mouthReach (the Río Quinto sink reach, 61512430) to the first reach outside the province, then adds the HydroBASINS level-12 drainage upstream of it, minus the province and the other roots. A clipped root is its wholeLayer polygon cut by the province edge, so every internal border comes from one layer. sliverMaxKm2: interior rings smaller than this in the outline and root polygons are filled (gaps between APRHI polygons, not real enclaves); larger outline holes go to the root whose wholeLayer polygon covers at least half of them (reported in slivers.holesGivenToRoots). Paths are relative to data/raw/.

reference.source: No single official figure for this region: the per-root APRHI areas are the reference, checked in the report.
